title: Between Flight and Fall
altText: Original painting of a Cuban tocororo bird resting after a fall, exploring themes of transformation, displacement, memory, and renewal.
shortDescription: A Cuban tocororo caught between devastation and transformation, suspended in the uncertain space between falling and flight.
longDescription: The fall has already happened. The tocororo remains on the ground, devastated and disoriented, its gaze fixed somewhere beyond the horizon. Between memory and transformation, it occupies an uncertain space where loss is undeniable and the future remains unwritten.
seoTitle: Between Flight and Fall | Original Painting | Sylva Ars Studio
seoDescription: Between Flight and Fall is an original painting featuring a Cuban tocororo in a moment of transition between collapse and renewal. The work explores themes of transformation, displacement, resilience, memory, and personal change through symbolic imagery and expressive color.

title: Who am I?
altText: Original self-portrait exploring identity, memory, and the quiet process of becoming through expressive color and contemporary realism.
shortDescription: A self-portrait suspended between observation and introspection, where identity is shaped not by answers, but by the questions that remain.
longDescription: This self-portrait is not an attempt to define who I am, but to witness the ongoing process of becoming. Every brushstroke records a moment of uncertainty, curiosity, and reflection. Rather than offering certainty, the painting invites the viewer into the same question that guided its creation: Who am I? The answer is left unfinished, allowing memory, experience, and time to complete the portrait.
seoTitle: Who am I | Original Painting | Sylva Ars Studio
seoDescription: Original contemporary self-portrait painting exploring identity, memory, and self-discovery. Discover 'Who Am I?' by Cuban artist Adrian at Sylva Ars Studio.
